*Constable Pandey ki file thane ki almar mein 'closed' ho jaati hai. Ghulam Chacha apne bete ke garage mein baithe chai pee rahe hain — 30 saal baad, bina register ke.*
*Kohre ki aakhri parat mein ek awaaz aati hai, halki si.*
Meenu: "Thank you, bhaiya. Bus aa gayi."
*Tumhari gaadi 3:07 se pehle wali state mein start ho jaati hai. Dashboard par ek lifafa rakha hai — is baar naya. Uspar likha hai: 'Chacha — karza chuka. — M.'*
*Radio 104.6 par aaj koi request nahi aati. Sirf ek gaana bajta hai, aur ek aadmi ki awaaz: 'Aur bhai... aaj sab log ghar pahunch gaye. Chalo, aage.'*
fallbackLines: *Kahani poori — hisaab close.*

scenes.title: Ab Counter Tumhara Hai
narration: *Tum chai banaate ho. Theek waise hi jaise Ghulam Chacha banate the — teen glass, bina pooche, cheeni kisi ke liye nahi.*

*Dhaba abhi bhi yahi hai. Meenu abhi bhi apni kursi par hai, par ab woh hasti hai — kyunki uska lifafa Nashik pahunch gaya hai. Uska bhai har 15 din ko aata hai; ab uska bhi naam board par hai, 'Meenu ka bhai — 5 baar aaya, kabhi andar nahi ghusa'.*
Ghulam Chacha: "Ek saal. Bas ek saal. Phir koi aur 'K' aayega. Usse sawaal poochhna mat — sirf chai dena."
*Constable Pandey apni file tumhare haath mein dete hain. Aakhri line ab adhoori nahi: 'Chautha ka naam: {{playerName}}'.*
Constable Pandey: "Procedure pura. Ab tum dekho."
*Aur bahar kohra apna kaam karta hai. 3:12. Tube light flicker. Ek gaadi rukti hai. Tum darwaaza kholte ho — andar se, muskurate hue.*
"Aao. Chai thandhi ho rahi hai."
fallbackLines: *Kahani yahin khatam hoti hai. Dhaba nahi.*

scenes.title: Hamesha 3:12
narration: *Tum ponchhte ho. Mitti gir'ti hai. Naam halka hota hai — par jaata nahi. Darwaaza tum kholte ho aur bahar jaate ho — aur har baar sadak ghum kar usi mod par aa jaati hai.*
*Chhathi baar, ya saatvi, tum bhaagna band kar dete ho. Andar aate ho. Meenu tumhare liye jagah chhod deti hai. Pandey register aage sarkaate hain. Ghulam Chacha chai daalte hain.*
Ghulam Chacha: "Koi baat nahi, beta. Yahan bahut log aate hain jo 'jaana' chahte hain. Jo ruk jaate hain, unhe aaram milta hai."
Meenu: "Bhaiya, aap mere saath baitho. Bus abhi nahi aayegi. Aur agar aap ruk gaye, toh mujhe bhi acha lagega."
*Radio 104.6. Ek request aati hai: 'Driver Balwant, mere liye ruk jao.' Balwant ka truck 40 minute se usi mod par para hai, engine chalu.*
*Ghadi 3:12 par hai. Subah nahi hoti. Aur tum — pehli baar apni gaadi lock karna bhool jaate ho. Darwaaza khula rehta hai. Kyunki ab tumhe yahan aane mein dar nahi lagta.*
*Blackboard par ek line judti hai: '{{playerName}} — yahin'. Naya mehmaan aaega. Teen kursiyan hamesha teen hi rehti hain.*
fallbackLines: *Kahani yahin ruk'ti hai. Ya shuru hoti hai. 3:12.*

endings.title: 5:40 — Kohra Hat'ta Hai
endings.description: Sach bahar aa gaya, lifafa bhai tak pahuncha, teenon ke hisaab close — aur dhaba gayab.

endings.title: Ab Counter Tumhara Hai
endings.description: Tumne doosron ka karza chukaya, apna likhwa liya. Dhaba ko naye maalik mil gaye.

endings.title: Hamesha 3:12
endings.description: Bhaagne se kuch nahi hua. Ab dhaba tumhara ghar hai — aur tum pehle se behtar host ho.
